body:
Hi @AntoineDuComptoirDesPharmacies,

The values passed in `on` do need to be escaped for them to work properly with other widgets such as `CurrentRefinements`.

One way to apply negative filters would be to use `Configure` with `NOT brand:Apple` in `filters`.

Alternatively you could create your own connector and use the [`toggleFacetExclusion`](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/reference.html#AlgoliaSearchHelper%23toggleFacetExclusion) method from the helper.
